title: Mondropolon language
description: West Manus language of Papua New Guinea
extract: The Mondropolon language is a West Manus language spoken by approximately 300 people on north-central Manus Island, Manus Province of Papua New Guinea. Its speakers also use Kurti. It has SVO word order.
